title: echinopsis maximiliana subsp. westii
intro: Echinopsis maximiliana subsp. westii, commonly known as the West's pitaya or San Pedro cactus, is a species of cactus in the genus Echinopsis. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Echinopsis maximiliana subsp. westii include its ability to induce feelings of euphoria and relaxation, as well as its potential to increase alertness and energy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, specifically mescaline, which is responsible for its psychoactive properties, as well as other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids.
